text: わたしに　はむかう　なら　いたい　めに　あって　もらう！

structure.jp: わたしに　はむかう　なら
いたい　めに　あって　もらう！
structure.en: I'll have you suffer for it!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: てもらう after a verb means having someone do it; said as a threat it means 'I will make you'. あって　もらう = 'I'll have you go through it'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. はむかう　なら = 'if you defy me'.
